text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki, an Umamusume who mastered 
the unarmed martial art Kongo Yaegaki-ryu. 
Her challenge in the Twinkle Series had 
begun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her youth, she was an outlaw who threw 
tantrums and used rough behavior to bend 
others to her will.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her grandfather, a grandmaster, 
taught her martial arts, allowing her to 
master emotional control. She calms the 
passionate "raging fire" with "still 
water"—achieving the harmony of "Fire and 
Water as One."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She aims to apply "Unification of Fire and 
Water" to racing as well, and win through 
that running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To show the grandparents who raised her 
how much she had grown. With gratitude in 
her heart, Yaeno Muteki's battle began!
